profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company that describes itself as pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility worldwide. According to its site, it was founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley and is headquartered in Guangzhou. The company says it develops autonomous driving technology globally and has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios. It reports that its autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations.

The company organizes its work around three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). It describes its core technology as a "virtual driver" and positions itself at the forefront of autonomous driving across those units, with the stated aim of serving both everyday travel and commercial logistics. Pony AI describes itself as an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving and as a pioneer in extending autonomous mobility technologies and services across an expanding footprint of sites.

Pony AI Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker PONY, with a headquarters address listed in Guangzhou.
